name: How long does a kitchen remodel usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen remodel usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen remodel depends on its complexity and scale. A smaller, cosmetic update might be completed in 3-5 weeks. A more extensive remodel involving significant layout changes, custom cabinetry, and new plumbing/electrical work typically takes 8-12 weeks from demolition to final touches. This timeline includes planning, material ordering, and construction phases. We establish a clear project schedule at the outset and keep you informed of progress.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen remodel can take 3-5 weeks for minor updates or 8-12 weeks for extensive renovations, depending on project scope.
